[SWS_PHM_01353]
{DRAFT}
Keep Elementary Supervision Status
kDEACTIVATED
⌈
If the
Elementary Supervision Status
is
kDEACTIVATED
then, unless there
is a switch to a
Supervision Mode
(due to change in corresponding
Function
Group
State) in which the corresponding supervision is configured to be monitored
AND
•
for
Alive Supervision
: the corresponding Process reports Execution State
kRunning
•
for
Deadline Supervision
and
Logical Supervision
: any checkpoint
corresponding to the supervision is reported
the
Platform Health Management
shall not perform the supervision and keep
the
Elementary Supervision Status kDEACTIVATED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111, RS_-
PHM_00104)
